owned_invariants: Requests are closed JSON: unknown fields, unknown colours, unknown DDC letters and duplicate ids are refused or reported as findings.
An operation is HOST_VERIFIED only if it has a body and every host check on it reproduced the expected value; a body-less operation stays UNVERIFIED_CANDIDATE.
Any failed check or bad reference makes the candidate not accepted; a duplicated id leaves neither copy typed.
respond returns exactly one of PASS, FAIL or REFUSED for every command; FAIL carries the report of a check that ran and did not hold.
witness and trial answer PASS when the host wrote the record and REFUSED otherwise; neither has a FAIL.
run answers PASS only when its report is accepted.
version states the crate name, the crate version and the canon schema version, so a workflow can bind a run to the host that checked it.
witness-turn, ledger load and ledger trial answer PASS when the host wrote the record or the seed and REFUSED otherwise; none has a FAIL.
ledger loaded answers PASS only when the seed is what the ledger loads at the stated head, and FAIL with both hashes when it is not.
boundaries: check compares with expected values the request lists; run (running.rs) is the command that takes none and compares with the judge.
Workflows reach it through pfp/infrastructure/operad_host.py, which carries the request and the outcome only.
